narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The median is twenty nine, so p must be twenty nine and nothing else.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But put p as forty. The sixth place is still twenty nine.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The value p does not have to be the median itself.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check a choice, put p into the ordered list and count to the sixth place.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Try one choice below twenty nine and one above. See which keeps twenty nine sixth.
